controlNotes: Selected 32 m lattice assembly remains fixed length. Boom angle 45–70 degrees and hook height 2–22 m are chosen visual simulation limits, not a manufacturer operating plan. Set BOOM_PIVOT absolute local glTF Z rotation to positive angle, preserve commanded hook ground height, and reanchor HOOK horizontal position to BOOM_TIP. Update every endpoint link after boom/slew/hook changes using parent-local endpoint coordinates, start origin, +Y-to-direction quaternion and Y scale equal to endpoint distance. Link geometry is a unit +Y line; pendant anchors follow the gantry and fixed boom attachment. Suspension-line lengths illustrate luffing reeving without an engineering winch model. Hook rope endpoint uses the main head sheave centre and hook-block top reference; no auxiliary or fixed jib is fitted.
